title: Vera business valuation case envelope
description: Local development workpaper contract. Validate this envelope before source reads, then $defs.selectedMethod independently for each selected method. Invalid method payloads remain blocked workpapers. Review eligibility, cross-record references, date ordering, source receipts and financial judgments are separate runtime or professional checks. No external schema retrieval.

review.description: Raw local attestation retained for diagnostics. Runtime checks the exact dependency digest, accepted decision, named reviewer and timezone-aware timestamp; a structurally valid case never grants acceptance.

inputs.description: Validated against the selected-method definition inside the per-method diagnostic boundary.

selectedMethod.description: Validate each selected method independently after the case envelope. Structural validity does not establish reference existence, arithmetic validity or economic appropriateness.
